hints.title: Reverse Optimization
hints.text: Maximizing the score of deleted elements is equivalent to minimizing the elements left behind in the array.

hints.title: Odd Length Analysis
hints.text: If the array length is odd, exactly one element remains at the end, so leaving the minimum single element achieves the maximum score.

hints.title: Even Length Analysis
hints.text: If the array length is even, exactly two elements remain. Because edge deletions preserve adjacency, the remaining two elements must be adjacent in the original array.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Single linear scan over adjacent pairs and total sum.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating all deletion branches leads to exponential branching.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identify the remaining element invariant based on parity and minimize the leftover sum.
